Longchamp Paris Smoking Pipe Lot
Vintage Algerian Briar Collection
Leather-Wrapped, 3 Pieces, With Original Case
A vintage collection of smoking pipes from The Longchamp Pipe Company, Paris. Renowned for their signature leather-wrapped designs, Longchamp pipes were traditionally crafted using century-old Algerian briar, selected in the Jura mountains and hand-finished in Paris. This lot represents the classic mid-century French pipe-making tradition, highly regarded by collectors for the unique aesthetic and cooling properties of the leather dressing.
Items Included:
Longchamp Smoking Pipe: Leather-wrapped briar bowl, straight black stem, marked Longchamp France.
Longchamp Smoking Pipe: Cream-colored bowl with black bit, straight billiard-style silhouette.
Longchamp Smoking Pipe: Leather-wrapped briar bowl, dark brown hand-sewn leather, black stem.
Original Presentation Case: Red exterior clamshell case with green velvet-style lining and branded silk interior lid.
Certificate of Authenticity: Original parchment document from The Longchamp Pipe Company certifying materials and origin.
Condition:
The pipes are in used vintage condition. Bowls show significant charring and carbon buildup from previous use. Stems exhibit tooth marks and light oxidation. The leather wrapping shows surface scuffs, discoloration, and age-related wear consistent with handling. The presentation case has visible staining on the interior silk lining and light exterior shelf wear. The included certificate is folded and shows age-toning but remains fully legible. description:
Glass Insulator Lot - 3 Pieces
Hemingray and American Manufactured
Aqua Teal and Clear, Vintage Mid-Century Era
This collection of three vintage glass insulators represents a significant era in American telecommunications history. Used primarily to insulate telegraph and telephone wires from their wooden support poles, these heavy glass pieces are prized by collectors for their industrial aesthetic and vibrant glass colors. This lot provides a balanced display including a classic aqua teal piece and two clear glass specimens.
Pieces Included:
Hemingray Insulator, Aqua Teal Glass, embossed "HEMINGRAY" with beaded drip points - minor base fleabites
Clear Glass Insulator, embossed "MADE IN U.S.A.", smooth base - excellent vintage condition
Unmarked Clear Glass Insulator, smooth base - excellent vintage condition
Condition:
The lot is in very good vintage condition. The teal Hemingray insulator shows typical minor chipping and roughness along the drip points on the base, which is characteristic of utility-grade glass. The clear insulators are notably well-preserved with no significant chips or cracks. All pieces retain their original glossy transparency without signs of glass disease or mineral cloudiness.

Mixing Flat-Rate & Dimensional Weight Items
When an order includes both flat-rate and dimensional-weight items, shipping may be calculated using dimensional weight. Combining these items does not necessarily reduce shipping costs and may result in the same or higher shipping charges than purchasing them separately.
For this reason, customers may want to consider purchasing flat-rate and dimensional-weight items in separate orders.
Flat-Rate Shipping
Flat-rate shipping charges are fixed and
cannot be adjusted or discounted
.
When multiple flat-rate items are purchased together, the shipping charge for each item is added to the order. For example, if three items each have a $5.99 flat-rate shipping charge, the total shipping charge will be $17.97
Shipping via FedEx:
All items will ship via FedEx. FedEx shipping charges are calculated using the dimensional weight (volume) or the actual weight of the shipped package - whichever weight is higher. The listed weight of this item(s) may reflect the dimensional shipping charge for the final package, and not the actual weight of the item(s). FedEx cannot ship to a Military Box, PO Box, or Puerto Rico. Orders with a tracking number assigned on a weekend are picked up by the carrier on Monday afternoon. Any order with items totaling $300 or more will automatically require a signature.

Glass Insulator Lot - 3 Pieces
Hemingray, Ohio Valley Glass Co. (O.V.G. Co.)
Aqua and Teal Green, Vintage
Collection of three vintage glass insulators originally utilized for telegraph and telephone line insulation. This lot features insulators from prominent American manufacturers, showcasing the industrial aqua and teal green glass common to early 20th-century utility production. These heavy pressed glass pieces are sought after for their historical industrial aesthetic and display appeal.

Insulator, Aqua, marked "O.V.G. CO." - features a large chip on the side and base
Insulator, Teal Green, marked "N 21" - internal vertical crack visible on the crown

description:
German Hunter Style Tobacco Pipe
Munchen Edition, Modular Construction
Wood, Metal, and Horn, Approximately 6 Inches Long
A classic German "Jager" or hunter-style tobacco pipe, featuring the traditional modular multi-piece construction characteristic of Central European alpine regions. This specific piece is detailed with "Munchen" (Munich) engraved on the bowl, identifying it as a regional piece from the Bavarian capital. Designed for functionality in outdoor settings, these pipes feature long stems to cool the smoke and wind caps to protect the embers.
Modular design consisting of a polished wood bowl, bark-covered wooden stem section, and horn mouthpiece transition
Decorative hinged metal wind cap with ornate perforations and a secure latch mechanism
Accented with a traditional green cord featuring wooden toggle beads and a small decorative tassel
Engraved "Munchen" banner design on the side of the bowl
Condition:
The item is in used condition with visible charring and residue inside the bowl from previous use. The exterior wood finish retains a high gloss with minor surface handling marks. Metal components, including the bands and wind cap, show light tarnish and age-related patina. The modular joints fit securely. The green decorative cord is intact with some minor fraying to the tassel.

This item adds character to any science-themed room or classroom and invites hands-on exploration of ancient natural wonders.

Natural Amethyst Crystal Cluster
Deep Purple Geode Fragment
Natural Mineral Specimen, 3.47 Pounds
This substantial amethyst crystal cluster features a dense concentration of terminated quartz points in varying shades of deep purple. A classic geological specimen, amethyst is prized by collectors for its vibrant coloration and unique crystalline formations, often used as a centerpiece for home decor or within mineral collections for its aesthetic and geological interest.
Numerous natural crystal terminations with characteristic hexagonal faceting
Deep purple saturation with translucent to semi-opaque clarity across the points
Natural rocky matrix base providing a stable foundation for upright display
Substantial size with a verified weight of 3.47 pounds
Condition:
Natural specimen with primary crystalline structures intact. No large-scale shearing or significant damage to the main cluster terminations. The underside displays the raw, unpolished host rock matrix typical of geode extractions. Natural mineral inclusions and slight surface dust consistent with storage are present.
